## Recommendations

### Color Usage
- Use `primary` for main brand elements (buttons, links, headers)
- Use `secondary` for supporting elements (badges, tags)
- Use `accent` for calls-to-action and highlights
- Ensure WCAG 2.1 AA compliance (4.5:1 contrast for normal text)
